# simple KDIGO per admission ever
def kd(g):
    v=g.value.values;t=g.collect_time.values
    for i in range(len(v)):
        w48=(t>=t[i]-np.timedelta64(48,'h'))&(t<t[i]); w7=(t>=t[i]-np.timedelta64(168,'h'))&(t<t[i])
        if w48.any() and v[i]-v[w48].min()>=0.3: return True
        if w7.any() and v[i]>=1.5*v[w7].min(): return True
    return False
k=cr.groupby('admission_id').apply(kd).rename('aki')
dx=d.groupby('admission_id').agg(n=('seq','size'),n17=('icd_code',lambda s:(s=='N17.9').any()))
x=a[['admission_id']].merge(k,on='admission_id',how='left').merge(dx,on='admission_id',how='left').fillna({'n':0,'n17':False})
print(x.aki.mean()); print(pd.crosstab(x.aki,x.n17)); print(x.groupby('aki').n.mean())
print(d.groupby('admission_id').size().describe())
